import sys
from collections import defaultdict

def findString(s):
    chars = sorted(set(s), reverse=True)
    n = len(chars)
    dp = defaultdict(lambda: 1, {(chars[i], 1): 1 for i in range(n)})
    prev = defaultdict(lambda: -1)

    max_len = 1
    best_start, best_diff = chars[0], 1

    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i):
            diff = chars[i] - chars[j]
            if diff > 0:
                length = dp[(chars[j], diff)] + 1
                dp[(chars[i], diff)] = length
                prev[(chars[i], diff)] = chars[j]
                if length > max_len or (length == max_len and chars[i] > best_start):
                    max_len = length
                    best_start, best_diff = chars[i], diff

    result = []
    current = best_start
    while current != -1:
        result.append(current)
        current = prev[(current, best_diff)]

    return ''.join(result)

input = sys.stdin.read().strip()
print(findString(input))
